meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed official Google typed RetryInfo and QuotaFailure, Vercel AI SDK step telemetry and OpenTelemetry error conventions; native bounded metadata, exact delay and tool-continuation tests; direct advertised-tool prompt guidance.

auth.review_note: Canonical configured username or email matches only the existing owner identity, still requiring password_verify. No credential changes or default password introduced.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed backend skill and commerce data contracts; read-only model-selected facts do not change payment, order, catalogue or checkout writes.

content.review_note: Reviewed browser snapshot bounds, per-owner and page key, revision conflict, explicit save token cleanup and unchanged MySQL CAS and publication status.

foundation.review_note: Compared the documented deployment checks with the actual workflow and native application boundaries. The changes run in tests and GitHub Actions and introduce no application server, data or hosting mutation.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the frontend skill addition alongside consent-aware Google tag rendering. The change applies only to enquiry-card text and introduces no script, tag or consent dependency.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed request-failure and hosting guidance against the probe error handling. Retry is bounded to the read-only revision GET, honors server guidance and does not assert deployment on network or HTTP failure.

interface.review_note: Matched the shared muted label color to the white card surface and WCAG small-text requirement. Checked the four actual page consumers at 1280px and 375px, the About CSS failure case and native enquiry navigation.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the AdminController diff against queue, outbox and delivery guidance; only users() directory selection and metadata changed.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the shared site layout and settings guide. Brand-only favicon fallback does not change MCP client grants, prerequisites or URLs.

media.review_note: Reviewed the added admin UI skill guidance alongside guarded media deletion and the sidebar Media Library link; the route and media workflows retain their existing semantics.

operator-help.review_note: Checked Customers help against the owner route, email-matched history, account segments, native combined filters and IST date boundaries; Help for this page still resolves the same guide.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked the route inventory. The MediaService relation describes an existing owner appearance POST and introduces no public tool.

remote-commerce.review_note: Cross-checked the shared enquiry-card token on Home and Shop against the commerce and checkout guidance. Browser navigation reaches the existing contact form; no cart, order or checkout behavior changed.

sales-channels.review_note: Confirmed the existing catalogue optimiser and filename handling remain the default. Only brand uploads retain the original raster type.

workflow.review_note: Checked exact HEAD verification before and after both unchanged browser suites, serial release execution, fixture checks in CI and the independent deployment gate.
